title: dispatch wave: scope to one feature and bound the batch
action: Review P1: bee dispatch wave with no --feature claims and reserves the first schedule wave across EVERY feature (prepare.rs:1374 list_cells(root, None, None)) — a mutating verb inherited cells schedule read-only all-features default. Fix: resolve the target feature as --feature when given, else the calling session bound lane/active feature (follow how sibling verbs resolve it); refuse with a typed message naming --feature when none resolves. Add optional --limit <n> (positive integer) capping how many cells of the wave are claimed, so speculative claims are bounded by what the caller can spawn; without it, keep the whole wave. Also (review P2, same file): call unwind_wave_claim on the Err arm at prepare.rs:1398-1408 so a failed claim+reserve never leaks a claim with partial reservations, name the leaked cell in the skip detail if the unwind itself fails, and classify an UNWIND FAILED message as its own reason (not reservation_conflict) in wave_skip_reason (prepare.rs:1267-1275). Update registry_payload.json and router.rs for the new/required flags (string surgery per wfl-2/wfl-4 precedent) and run bee dev regen at the end. Tests: no feature resolvable refuses; a wave never spans a second feature; --limit caps the claims; an Err mid-reserve leaves no claim behind.

truths: A wave never claims a cell outside the resolved feature
No resolvable feature is a typed refusal, never a silent all-features grab
A mid-reserve failure leaves no claim and no partial reservation

trace.outcome: Scoped dispatch wave to one resolved feature (refusing when none resolves), added --limit to bound the claimed batch, and unwound a mid-reserve claim leak with its own unwind_failed skip reason.

report.outcome: Scoped dispatch wave to one resolved feature (refusing when none resolves), added --limit to bound the claimed batch, and unwound a mid-reserve claim leak with its own unwind_failed skip reason.
deviations: unwind_wave_claim is a private fn in prepare.rs, unreachable from cells/tests.rs (the only test file this cell scopes); the mid-reserve Err(_) branch is documented in-file as unreachable in practice through the CLI, so its guarantee is proven indirectly via a direct unit test on the sibling wave_skip_reason classifier and the unwind-note text the Err(_) arm now always emits, rather than a black-box repro of the mid-reserve failure itself.

skills/bee-swarming/SKILL.md and docs/knowledge/areas/workflow-state/dispatch.md were outside the cells files list but named in the cell prompt Inputs as conditional on --feature becoming required; edited and reserved under hpf-2 since the prompt pre-authorized the edit.

checks.evidence: prepare.rs:1416-1434 resolves via resolve_mutation_lock_scope (ledger.rs:155-177: explicit flag, session binding, default record, else None); None is a typed refusal, and cells are listed with Some(feature) at prepare.rs:1450 so no input can produce a cross-feature claim; --feature "" collapses to None and hits the refusal
prepare.rs:1463-1466 truncates wave_ids before the claim loop at :1473
